hints.title: Permutation Index Equivalence
hints.text: The array is a permutation of integers from zero up to n minus one. When can a chunk be safely partitioned without spilling elements into other chunks?

hints.title: Running Maximum Index Invariant
hints.text: If the maximum value observed from the start up to index i equals i, then all elements observed so far belong exclusively to the range zero through i.

hints.title: Single Pass Prefix Maximum Counting Procedure
hints.text: Initialize chunks and running maximum to zero. Iterate through the array with index i. Update the running maximum with the current element. Whenever the running maximum equals i, increment the chunk counter. Return the total count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force partition testing requires checking all exponential 2^(N-1) partition possibilities.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan tracking the running maximum runs in O(N) time and requires only O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice that the elements are a permutation of [0, n-1] and deduce the condition max_seen == i.
